newsitem.title: USA: Richey sees Q3 weaker than Q2.
newsitem.headline: Richey sees Q3 weaker than Q2.

text.p: Richey Electronics Inc said Tuesday it would have trouble meeting analysts expectations for the third quarter.
The company said it has had a high number of customers rescheduling orders for delivery in 30 days or less.
Richey said it expects to see a decline in third-quarter sales compared with the second quarter and said that net income may also decline in Q3 from Q2.
The company said the effect of customers reducing inventory stocking levels has been cushioned by higher gross margins thereby lessening the effect on earnings.
Richey said it does not anticipate a change in sales outlook while the trend of order rescheduling continues.
Shares of Richey, which makes electronic components, closed 1/4 lower at 10 on Nasdaq.
